description: Visit a profile from your connected account (the 'viewed you' signal). Costs $0.005 per action. Give person_ref or profile_ref. Requires a connected account. While GET /pricing does not list this route in its family's available_routes it answers 503 temporarily_unavailable and nothing is charged.

account_id.description: Which connected account (accounts_list). Optional while this key has exactly one.

person_ref.description: The person reference from a profile or search result.

profile_ref.description: A person's public identifier or profile address.

name: person_visit
title: Visit a Profile
